brief_title: Efficacy and Safety of Three Times a Day BIAsp-70 Compared to Two Times a Day BIAsp-30 in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes
official_title: Trial to Investigate the Efficacy and the Safety of Thrice-Daily NN2000-Mix70 (NovoRapid 70 Mix) Compared to Twice-Daily NN-X14Mix30 (NovoRapid 30 Mix) in Subjects With Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus
brief_summary: This trial is conducted in Japan. This a clinical trial to study the efficacy and safety of three times a day BIAsp-70 compared to two times a day BIAsp-30 in subjects with type 2 diabetes.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects with type 2 diabetes
* Current treatment using intermediate-acting, long-acting insulin (including long-acting insulin analogue) or pre-mixed human insulin for at least 24 weeks
* HbA1c at least 7.5% and below 10.0%

Exclusion Criteria:

* Proliferative retinopathy or maculopathy requiring acute treatment
* Impaired hepatic and/or renal function
* Cardiac diseases
* Uncontrolled hypertension
* Known hypoglycemia unawareness or recurrent major hypoglycemia
